text:
A magnetic field does not exert a force on a stationary electric charge.
A magnetic field exerts a force on a moving electric charge.
Which statement explains this?
A
A moving charge has an electric field.
B
A moving charge has a gravitational field.
C
A moving charge has a magnetic field.
D
A moving charge has kinetic energy.

options.label: A
options.text: A moving charge has an electric field.

options.label: B
options.text: A moving charge has a gravitational field.

options.label: C
options.text: A moving charge has a magnetic field.

options.label: D
options.text: A moving charge has kinetic energy.
